de: Brixton Market (inklusive Brixton Village) ist am Wochenende am lebhaftesten und bietet eine großartige Atmosphäre.
Verpassen Sie nicht das berühmte David-Bowie-Wandgemälde in der Nähe der U-Bahn-Station.
Die Victoria Line verbindet Brixton extrem schnell mit dem Zentrum Londons.
Viele kleine Restaurants in Brixton Village akzeptieren nur Kartenzahlung, während einige Marktstände Bargeld bevorzugen.
hu: A Brixton piac (beleértve a Brixton Village-t is) hétvégén a legnyüzsgőbb és leghangulatosabb.
Ne hagyd ki a híres David Bowie emlékművet a metróállomás közelében.
A Victoria vonal rendkívül gyorsan összeköti Brixtont London központjával.
A Brixton Village sok kis étterme csak kártyát fogad el, de az utcai árusoknál legyen nálad készpénz.
ro: Piața Brixton (inclusiv Brixton Village) este cea mai vibrantă și aglomerată în weekenduri.
Nu ratați muralul memorial dedicat lui David Bowie, situat lângă stația de metrou.
Linia Victoria conectează Brixton direct și foarte rapid de centrul Londrei.
Multe restaurante independente din Brixton Village acceptă doar plata cu cardul, deși unii comercianți din piață preferă numerarul.
en: Brixton Market (including Reliance Arcade, Market Row, and Brixton Village) is busiest and most vibrant on weekends.
Explore the musical heritage, including the David Bowie memorial mural near the tube station.
The Victoria Line connects Brixton directly to central London very quickly.
Many independent food stalls in Brixton Village only accept card payments, though some market traders still prefer cash.
